AGL ERP Systems

A working ERP for Automobiles Ghana Ltd, connecting sales, workshop, HR, administration and finance workflows.

Work & features

  • Translated operational requirements into system specifications and coordinated implementation.
  • Replaced disconnected paper and WhatsApp processes with centralized data capture and operational reporting.
  • Supported staff adoption through training in data capture, reporting, teamwork and workplace ethics.
  • Production-ready ERP delivered in under 32 weeks during the October 2024–July 2026 role.

Tools & methods

  • JavaScript
  • Google Sheets API
  • PWA
  • Kanban
  • QR staff access

Public access currently opens a sign-in screen; authenticated workflows were not re-tested in this review. The GHS 1,200 to 2,700 campaign was a 2024 result, not a current ERP metric. Earlier publication-safe dashboard evidence remains in the project document.

Independent analytics projectIN PROGRESS

Olist Marketing Funnel & E-Commerce Analysis

Python analysis of lead conversion, commerce-linked sellers and seller-to-customer delivery corridors using public Olist data.

Work & features

  • Preserves one row per marketing lead by aggregating commerce records before joining seller data.
  • Repository-verified results: 8,000 leads, 842 closed deals, 10.53% conversion, 380 commerce-linked deals and 45.13% commerce-link rate.
  • Validates 97,811 eligible seller-order records across 412 state corridors; dashboard exports and Looker Studio publication remain pending.

Tools & methods

  • Python
  • pandas
  • Matplotlib
  • Jupyter
  • GitHub Codespaces

Independent, self-directed project inspired by MIT OpenCourseWare materials. No MIT enrollment, credential, submission, endorsement or institutional credit.
